name: Workout Types Crosswalk 2026 (HealthKit, Health Connect, Wear OS, Google Health API)
methodology: Every workout or exercise type constant on four platforms, read up to 2026-10-18: Apple's HKWorkoutActivityType cases (names, abstracts, groups and availability from Apple's documentation JSON, discussions from each case's own page), Health Connect's ExerciseSessionRecord.EXERCISE_TYPE_* constants (values from Google's Jetpack reference; the platform API's ExerciseSessionType constant, value and API level each converts to, from IntDefMappings.kt in the androidx source and Google's platform reference; the segment types each accepts, from the table behind ExerciseSegment.isSegmentTypeCompatibleWithSessionType in ExerciseSegment.kt), Wear OS Health Services' ExerciseType constants (names and descriptions from Google's reference, ids from the androidx ExerciseType.kt it links) and the Google Health API's exerciseType enum (the v4 discovery document). Names, values and descriptions are copied exactly. HealthKit values are null because Apple prints none; Google Health API values are null because the enum value is the string itself. One column is DERIVED: crosswalkKey. Two constants share a crosswalk row only when their names are identical after removing a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ (Health Connect's prefix, which the Google Health API also uses on EXERCISE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED), lowercasing, and removing every character that is not a letter or a digit. sameNameOn lists the constants of the other platforms with the same key. No Apple or Google page read for this dataset maps one list onto another, so nothing is joined by meaning.
generatedFrom: src/data/workoutTypes.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-workout-types.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.constant: The constant exactly as the source spells it
fields.value: Health Connect: the Jetpack value. Wear OS: the id ExerciseType.kt passes. Null for HealthKit (Apple prints none) and the Google Health API (string enum)
fields.description: HealthKit: Apple's abstract. Others: the source's description; null where it gives none
fields.discussion: HealthKit: Apple's discussion paragraphs, verbatim; null where Apple gives none
fields.iosIntroduced: HealthKit: the iOS version Apple lists
fields.deprecated: yes when the source marks the constant deprecated; null where the source has no such field
fields.platformApiConstant: Health Connect: the platform ExerciseSessionType constant the Jetpack library converts to
fields.platformApiValue: Health Connect: that constant's value on the platform reference
fields.platformApiLevel: Health Connect: the API level the platform reference gives it
fields.platformApiDeprecatedIn: Health Connect: the API level the platform reference deprecates it in
fields.segmentRule: Health Connect: any, listed or universal-only (see the hub's segment section)
fields.segments: Health Connect: the segment types the library's table names for the session type, beyond the universal ones
fields.crosswalkKey: DERIVED: the name with a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ removed, lowercased, characters outside a-z0-9 removed
fields.sameNameOn: Constants of other platforms with the same crosswalkKey; null when none
fields.source: The source page the constant was read from
fields.page: This site's row for the constant
